subject: general
question: Which of the following changes did the Waqf (Amendment) Act, 2025 make?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Added Muslim women to boards**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Waqf (Amendment) Act, 2025 mandated the inclusion of **Muslim women** as members of State Waqf Boards to ensure gender representation and inclusivity.
 
• This amendment aimed to provide a platform for Muslim women to actively participate in the governance and management of Waqf properties.
 
• By including women, the amendment sought to address long-standing issues of gender disparity in decision-making roles within the Waqf Boards.
 
• The inclusion of Muslim women aligns with broader national and global efforts to promote gender equality in governance structures.
 
• The move was widely welcomed as a progressive step towards empowering Muslim women in community affairs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Waqf:**

 
 
• A waqf is an endowment made by a Muslim for religious, educational, or charitable purposes.
 
• Waqf properties are typically donated in perpetuity, and their income is used for the intended purpose.
 
• The management of Waqf properties is overseen by Waqf Boards established in each state under the Waqf Act, 1995.
 
 
 
• **Waqf Boards:**
 
 
• State Waqf Boards are statutory bodies responsible for administering Waqf properties in their respective states.
 
• The members of the board are appointed as per the provisions of the Waqf Act, which includes representation from various stakeholders.
 
 
 
• **Role of Women in Governance:**
 
 
• Inclusion of women in governance structures fosters diversity and better representation of community needs.
 
• Research shows that gender-balanced boards tend to have better decision-making processes and outcomes.
 
 
 
• **Other Amendments in the Waqf Act:**
 
 
• The Waqf Act has been amended multiple times to address issues such as transparency, dispute resolution, and better management of Waqf properties.
 
• Each amendment reflects efforts to modernize and make the administration of Waqf properties more efficient.
